{"notes":"Superseded in substance by PKIX-dzjn (2026-11-25): the algorithms this describes are implemented.

pkix-path/src/verifiers.rs dispatches RSA-PSS (OID_RSASSA_PSS, verifiers.rs:74), Ed25519 (OID_ED25519, :90) and ECDSA P-521 (OID_SECP521R1, :59, dispatched :213), and the rustcrypto umbrella feature is rsa + p256 + p384 + p521 + ed25519.

What is actually left is a different thing, and it is tracked in PKIX-dzjn: pkix-path default = ["rsa", "p256"], so a default build gets RSA and P-256 only. Per the project decision of this date, everything in RustCrypto should be available everywhere, which means changing the defaults rather than implementing anything.

Not closing these unilaterally since they are not mine to triage wholesale, but they should not be worked as written."}
